title: Custom Patriotic Semi Truck on American Flag Background Comforter
description:
This custom trucker comforter is designed especially for road legends who love the journey. Featuring a striking design, this soft and cozy comforter set makes a thoughtful personalized gift for family, friends, or any trucking enthusiast. Sleep in comfort and style while showcasing your passion for the open road.

Key Features

  • Personalized Touch: Customize your bedding set with a personalized name input for a truly unique gift.
  • Soft & Cozy Material: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric with whole-piece microfiber filling to prevent clumping or shifting.
  • Available Sizes: Choose from US Twin (68' x 88'), US Full (78' x 88'), US Queen (88' x 88'), or US King (104' x 88') options.
  • Included Components: Features 1 Duvet Cover (or Comforter) with optional matching pillowcases based on your selection.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water, air dry without heat, and quick-drying for effortless maintenance.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester
Color Amazing Flag Trucker
Pattern American Flag
Theme Trucker
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
